# Calendar years 1969-1971 data from Treasury Bulletin 1972-11 (page 74)

sales_1969 = 366
sales_1970 = 191
sales_1971 = 27

# Redemptions
redemptions_1969 = 76
redemptions_1970 = 154
redemptions_1971 = 124

# Totals
total_sales = sales_1969 + sales_1970 + sales_1971
total_redemptions = redemptions_1969 + redemptions_1970 + redemptions_1971

print(f'Total sales with accrued discount (1969-1971): {total_sales}')
print(f'Total redemptions (1969-1971): {total_redemptions}')

ratio = total_redemptions / total_sales
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(ratio, 2)}')
"
